C0739.title: Insider–Outsider Collusion to Steal and Sell Company Waste Cardboard Boxes, Illegally Profiting Over 690,000 Yuan, 9 Sentenced
C0739.summary: Employees colluded with external individuals to steal and sell company assets such as waste cardboard boxes, illegally profiting over 690,000 yuan. After the procuratorate initiated a public prosecution, nine defendants were sentenced. The case exposed supervision loopholes in the company's asset disposal process, allowing insiders to collude with outsiders.
